story_type: heavy rocket launch, both side boosters fly back and land
hook: Two of this rocket's boosters flew back and landed side by side.
narration: Two of this rocket's three boosters were about to fly home and land side by side.
It is a SpaceX Falcon Heavy, carrying NASA's Psyche spacecraft from Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center, on October 13, 2023.
Falcon Heavy is three rocket cores strapped together, with twenty-seven engines firing at liftoff.
It climbed straight up into the haze and vanished.
High above, the two outer boosters let go, flipped around and fired their engines again to fly back toward the coast.
outcome: Minutes after launch, both side boosters landed at SpaceX's Landing Zone 1 and Landing Zone 2 at Cape Canaveral.
title: Falcon Heavy boosters land side by side
description:
A SpaceX Falcon Heavy launched NASA's Psyche spacecraft from Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center on Oct. 13, 2023, and both side boosters landed back at Cape Canaveral minutes later, filmed from a helicopter.
